# Mercury

Banking and money movement · options checked 2026-10-27 · [how sources are chosen](../../docs/SOURCING.md)

**Mercury publishes its own tools for AI agents. Start with those.**

Mercury publishes nine agent skills and a command-line tool. Indexed: cash reconciliation, journal entry prep and transaction categorisation, which ask before any write, and the CLI, which can send payments with no confirmation step described. The skills repository has no licence file.

## Hosted by the vendor

- **https://mcp.mercury.com/mcp** — connect it in Claude as a custom connector (remote MCP server) and sign in with your Mercury account. Payment and transfer requests need approval inside Mercury; category and transaction updates apply straight away.
  Not on GitHub, so this index cannot watch it for changes.

## What to use

### From Mercury

- **[Mercury cash reconciliation](../../skills/mercury-cash-reconciliation/README.md)** — Skill · Changes records only after you approve · needs Mercury CLI or Mercury's MCP server, signed in · [source](https://github.com/MercuryTechnologies/mercury-skills/tree/main/skills/mercury-cash-reconciliation)
  Mercury's own skill for the bank side of a cash GL reconciliation: pulls an account's period activity from Mercury and lays it out for a reconciliation workbook.
- **[Mercury journal entry prep](../../skills/mercury-journal-entry-prep/README.md)** — Skill · Changes records only after you approve · needs Mercury CLI or Mercury's MCP server, signed in · [source](https://github.com/MercuryTechnologies/mercury-skills/tree/main/skills/mercury-journal-entry-prep)
  Mercury's own skill for AP accrual and cash-reclass entries sourced from Mercury transactions, laid out for a NetSuite journal import.
- **[Mercury transaction categorization](../../skills/mercury-autocategorize-transactions/README.md)** — Skill · Changes records only after you approve · needs Mercury CLI or Mercury's MCP server, signed in · [source](https://github.com/MercuryTechnologies/mercury-skills/tree/main/skills/mercury-autocategorize-transactions)
  Mercury's own skill that suggests expense categories for uncategorized Mercury transactions and applies the ones you approve.
- **[Mercury CLI](../../skills/mercury-cli/README.md)** — Developer toolkit · Can move money; Changes records without asking first · needs Mercury API token · [source](https://github.com/MercuryTechnologies/mercury-cli/tree/main)
  Mercury's own command-line tool for its API, usable by an agent: accounts, transactions, cards, recipients, invoices, statements and payments.
